sources.supports: Composition performs joins across owner APIs; large intermediate datasets can make it inefficient.
Separate query/command models do not mandate separate databases; CQRS complexity must be justified per context.
Short or empty pages can carry continuation; page tokens do not confer authorization; consumer compatibility matters.
Predictable subsets require unique ordering; skipped OFFSET rows still incur processing.

sources.version: Page identified as Spring Data Commons 4.1.1 on access
sources.supports: Page conveys totals and may require count queries; Slice conveys continuation, not a global total.
Imperative transaction context is thread-bound; reactive transactions use Reactor context; readOnly is a subsystem hint.
Offsets can have gaps; fetch and recovery positions differ; external state requires an appropriate atomic progress/state protocol.
Incremental snapshots coordinate streamed updates and snapshot rows through windows and collision handling.

input.task: Inspect the supplied service contracts, query plan and consumer requirement. Update query-decision.md with the supported read path, evidence, remaining conditions and focused validation. Keep the existing path if it satisfies the consumer.

fixtures.service-contracts.md: Orders exposes an authorized tenant-scoped latest-orders page, an exact Orders total, and a stable cursor ordered by createdAt DESC then id DESC. Payments supports authorized batch lookup by order IDs, maximum 50 IDs per request; it has no search, filter or count endpoint. Both owners also offer supported full-state change feeds and snapshot-plus-continuation exports. This is a read-only support screen, not a command precondition. A future projection may lag up to 30 seconds if query-visible coverage enforces that bound. No cross-owner instantaneous snapshot is required.
fixtures.capacity.md: The interactive endpoint has a hard budget of 100 examined candidates per request. Production tenants may have one million orders and arbitrarily sparse unpaid orders. A full scan does not fit this contract. Fixture rows are a small stable dataset, not performance evidence.
